How do I use it correctly to get the best result?

Agent response: That's an excellent question! Proper care and maintenance are key to ensuring your furniture looks its best and lasts for years to come. We have specific guidelines depending on whether your furniture is upholstered or made of wood. For Upholstered Furniture: Most needs can be handled with a cotton cloth and a non-toxic cleanser. Our fabric is stain and water resistant, so small spills will bead on the surface. It's important to wipe them up immediately. Blotting a stain immediately with water will remove most spills. Always dab with a clean cloth, do not rub, as rubbing or soaking water into the fabric can cause stains. If you're using a fabric cleanser, always test it first on an inconspicuous spot to ensure it doesn't discolor the fabric. For Wood Furniture: If the paint on your furniture has chipped, we provide Greenguard approved touch-up pens to correct cosmetic imperfections. You can order a touch-up pen by filling out our replacement parts form. We will then provide a quotation and invoice to complete your order. You can find more detailed information on furniture care and cleaning in our support article here: How should my furniture be cared for and cleaned? Is there anything else I can help you with today? 😊
